download_kaggle_dataset: download a kaggle dataset to a local directory using the kaggle cli and KaggleOrigin.DATASETS
download_kaggle_competition: download a kaggle competition dataset to a local directory using the kaggle cli and KaggleOrigin.COMPETITIONS
run_kaggle_command: run a kaggle cli command via subprocess and handle 404 or file not found errors
use_kaggleorigin_enum: use the KaggleOrigin enum to specify whether to download from datasets or competitions
review_download_kaggle_data: review the download_kaggle_data function to understand how it logs and delegates to the internal download helper
